caption:
Inflation just ticked up again. 📈
The Fed's favorite gauge (PCE) rose 3.8% in October from a year ago. Core, without food and energy, was 3.3%.
So if your last raise was under 3.8%, your paycheck may be buying a little less than before.
Did your raise beat inflation this year?
first_comment: Be honest: did your raise beat 3.8%? 👇
